notes: BLACKOUT v3.16 L1 on Robinhood Chain (4663), project https://playblackout.xyz. Accepted source: identity-md-launches/launch-1544-blackout-swarmdesk-bootstrap-robinhood commit 15100e6af0893008f2f09d534604dcc6c1e008b4, built with unchanged foundry.toml (solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200, cancun, viaIR false, bytecode_hash none). One evm_contracts launch deploys SwarmDesk at index 0, then EndowmentEscrow at index 1 with its desk resolved to this launch's SwarmDesk. Return both confirmed addresses, their indices and the single recorded L1 launch number in the deployment handoff. SwarmDesk authenticates and stores oracle answers; EndowmentEscrow forwards the canonical game's token balance once to its proven RewardPool. Protocol endpoints are compiled in. The eighth Desk word pins the project-wallet binder 0x6d51cBE774aeAe4dd40bCA2560E9bc2695A0d007; every other bind caller reverts Unauthorized. After L3, that wallet signs bind(REGISTRY, registryCreationCode, paramsCreationCode, N_A, 1, N_A, 0, N_TOKEN), where N_A is the recorded L3 application launch number and N_TOKEN is the recorded L2 token launch number. Binding proves Registry/Params creation and configuration, and requires the compiled-in LaunchFactory.positionOf(N_TOKEN) record to name the registry's token and market hook; merely echoing desk(), token() and gameConfigHash() is insufficient. Preserve N_TOKEN as wiring.tokenLaunch alongside the confirmed L1/L3 outputs for the keeper. Keepers defer answer execution until all L4 modules are registered and wiring is verified. Accepted low/informational findings remain as documented in docs/accepted-v316.md. Binding is one-time: losing the binder key before binding leaves the Desk unbound and the endowment in escrow; the binder cannot bypass the proofs. Names and constructor words are identical at commit 15100e6 and in the accepted working tree; the tree adds the accepted FarmRewards fix and regenerated SwarmCode/ModuleCode pins, so the attestation binds the creation hashes of whichever tree it publishes.
